scripts.build: npm run build -w @redline/web && npm run build -w @redline/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension --noEmit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-redline "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
